description: Ethereum mainnet fee reference. A static snapshot captured 2026-11-14, no input: the EIP-1559 execution fee rules (12.5 percent base-fee steps toward the half-limit target), the EIP-4844 blob market (6 target, 9 max per block), the observed 0.445 gwei base-fee reference with the 2026 sub-gwei era, and transfer, ERC-20, and swap cost scenarios computed at those reference levels, the capture date printed on every card. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: ethereum-fee-snapshot
